from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP

# --- CONSTANTS SECTION ---

# Sec 16(ia) - Standard Deduction
STD_DEDUCTION_OLD = Decimal("50000")  # Sec 16(ia)
STD_DEDUCTION_NEW = Decimal("75000")  # Sec 115BAC proviso

# Sec 24(b) - House Property Interest Cap (Old Regime)
HOUSE_PROPERTY_INTEREST_CAP_OLD = Decimal("200000")

# Sec 80C - Overall cap on investments (Old Regime)
SEC_80C_CAP = Decimal("150000")

# Sec 80CCD(1B) - Additional NPS contribution cap (Old Regime)
SEC_80CCD_1B_CAP = Decimal("50000")

# Sec 80D - Health Insurance Caps (Old Regime)
SEC_80D_SELF_FAMILY_NORMAL = Decimal("25000")
SEC_80D_SELF_FAMILY_SENIOR = Decimal("50000")
SEC_80D_PARENTS_NORMAL = Decimal("25000")
SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR = Decimal("50000")

# Sec 87A - Rebate Limits
REBATE_LIMIT_OLD = Decimal("500000")
REBATE_CAP_OLD = Decimal("12500")
REBATE_LIMIT_NEW = Decimal("1200000")
REBATE_CAP_NEW = Decimal("600000")

# Health and Education Cess Rate
CESS_RATE = Decimal("0.04")

# Surcharge Thresholds and Rates
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS = [
    Decimal("5000000"),    # 50 Lakhs
    Decimal("10000000"),   # 1 Crore
    Decimal("20000000"),   # 2 Crores
    Decimal("500000000"),  # 5 Crores (Old Regime only)
]

SURCHARGE_RATES_OLD = [
    Decimal("0.10"),
    Decimal("0.15"),
    Decimal("0.25"),
    Decimal("0.37"),
]

SURCHARGE_RATES_NEW = [
    Decimal("0.10"),
    Decimal("0.15"),
    Decimal("0.25"),
    Decimal("0.25"),  # Capped at 25% for new regime
]

# Tax Slabs (lower, upper_or_None, rate)
SLABS_OLD_BELOW_60 = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("250000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("250000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

SLABS_OLD_SENIOR = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("300000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("300000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

SLABS_OLD_SUPER_SENIOR = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

SLABS_NEW = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("400000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("400000"), Decimal("800000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("800000"), Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("1600000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("1600000"), Decimal("2000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("2000000"), Decimal("2400000"), Decimal("0.25")),
    (Decimal("2400000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]


def round_nearest_ten(amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """
    Sec 288A / 288B rounding:
    First drop paise (floor to whole rupees), then round to nearest multiple of 10
    where a last digit of 5 or more rounds UP.
    """
    floored = amount.quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)
    return floored.quantize(Decimal("10"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)


def compute_regime(inp: dict, is_new: bool) -> dict:
    gross_salary = Decimal(str(inp["gross_salary"]))
    age = int(inp["age"])
    hra_received = Decimal(str(inp["hra_received"]))
    basic_plus_da = Decimal(str(inp["basic_plus_da"]))
    rent_paid = Decimal(str(inp["rent_paid"]))
    rent_city_is_metro = bool(inp["rent_city_is_metro"])
    home_loan_interest = Decimal(str(inp["home_loan_interest"]))
    sec_80c = Decimal(str(inp["sec_80c"]))
    sec_80ccd_1b = Decimal(str(inp["sec_80ccd_1b"]))
    health_ins_self = Decimal(str(inp["health_ins_self"]))
    health_ins_parents = Decimal(str(inp["health_ins_parents"]))
    parents_senior = bool(inp["parents_senior"])

    trace = []
    
    # 1. Salary / Gross Total Income
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Gross Salary",
        "amount": str(gross_salary),
        "clause": "Sec 17(1)"
    })

    current_income = gross_salary

    if is_new:
        std_dedn = min(current_income, STD_DEDUCTION_NEW)
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Standard Deduction",
            "amount": str(-std_dedn),
            "clause": "Sec 16(ia) read with Sec 115BAC"
        })
        current_income -= std_dedn
        gti = max(Decimal("0"), current_income)
        
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Gross Total Income",
            "amount": str(gti),
            "clause": "Gross total income"
        })
        taxable_income = gti

    else:
        # Standard deduction
        std_dedn = min(current_income, STD_DEDUCTION_OLD)
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Standard Deduction",
            "amount": str(-std_dedn),
            "clause": "Sec 16(ia)"
        })
        current_income -= std_dedn

        # HRA Exemption
        hra_exempt = Decimal("0")
        if rent_paid > 0:
            cond_a = hra_received
            cond_b = max(Decimal("0"), rent_paid - (basic_plus_da * Decimal("0.10")))
            rate_c = Decimal("0.50") if rent_city_is_metro else Decimal("0.40")
            cond_c = basic_plus_da * rate_c
            hra_exempt = min(cond_a, cond_b, cond_c)
            hra_exempt = min(hra_exempt, current_income)

        if hra_exempt > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "HRA Exemption",
                "amount": str(-hra_exempt),
                "clause": "Sec 10(13A) read with Rule 2A"
            })
            current_income -= hra_exempt

        # House Property Loss
        hp_loss = min(home_loan_interest, HOUSE_PROPERTY_INTEREST_CAP_OLD)
        if hp_loss > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Loss from self-occupied house property set off",
                "amount": str(-hp_loss),
                "clause": "Sec 24(b) and Sec 71(3A)"
            })
            current_income -= hp_loss

        gti = max(Decimal("0"), current_income)
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Gross Total Income",
            "amount": str(gti),
            "clause": "Gross total income"
        })

        # Chapter VI-A Deductions
        # Sec 80C
        ded_80c = min(sec_80c, SEC_80C_CAP)
        if ded_80c > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80C",
                "amount": str(-ded_80c),
                "clause": "Sec 80C"
            })

        # Sec 80CCD(1B)
        ded_80ccd_1b = min(sec_80ccd_1b, SEC_80CCD_1B_CAP)
        if ded_80ccd_1b > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80CCD(1B)",
                "amount": str(-ded_80ccd_1b),
                "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)"
            })

        # Sec 80D
        limit_self = SEC_80D_SELF_FAMILY_SENIOR if age >= 60 else SEC_80D_SELF_FAMILY_NORMAL
        ded_80d_self = min(health_ins_self, limit_self)
        limit_parents = SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR if parents_senior else SEC_80D_PARENTS_NORMAL
        ded_80d_parents = min(health_ins_parents, limit_parents)
        ded_80d = ded_80d_self + ded_80d_parents

        if ded_80d > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80D",
                "amount": str(-ded_80d),
                "clause": "Sec 80D"
            })

        total_via = ded_80c + ded_80ccd_1b + ded_80d
        # Sec 80A(2) overall cap
        total_via = min(total_via, gti)

        if total_via > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Chapter VI-A Deductions",
                "amount": str(total_via),  # Positive here because it reduces GTI in sequence
                "clause": "Sec 80A(2)"
            })
            current_income -= total_via

        net_income_unrounded = max(Decimal("0"), current_income)
        
        # Sec 288A Rounding of total income
        total_income = round_nearest_ten(net_income_unrounded)
        income_rounding_diff = total_income - net_income_unrounded
        if income_rounding_diff != 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Rounding adjustment to total income",
                "amount": str(income_rounding_diff),
                "clause": "Sec 288A"
            })

        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Total Income",
            "amount": str(total_income),
            "clause": "Sec 288A"
        })
        taxable_income = total_income

    if is_new:
        total_income = taxable_income
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Total Income",
            "amount": str(total_income),
            "clause": "Sec 115BAC"
        })

    # Tax computation
    if is_new:
        slabs = SLABS_NEW
    else:
        if age >= 80:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_SUPER_SENIOR
        elif age >= 60:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_SENIOR
        else:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_BELOW_60

    # Calculate slab-wise tax
    raw_tax = Decimal("0")
    for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
        if taxable_income <= lower:
            break
        upper_bound = upper if upper is not None else taxable_income
        taxable_in_slab = min(taxable_income, upper_bound) - lower
        if taxable_in_slab > 0:
            slab_tax = taxable_in_slab * rate
            raw_tax += slab_tax
            upper_str = str(upper) if upper is not None else "Above"
            trace.append({
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": f"Tax at {rate*100}% on slab {lower} - {upper_str}",
                "amount": str(slab_tax),
                "clause": "First Schedule"
            })

    # Rebate Sec 87A
    rebate = Decimal("0")
    if is_new:
        if taxable_income <= REBATE_LIMIT_NEW:
            rebate = min(raw_tax, REBATE_CAP_NEW)
    else:
        if taxable_income <= REBATE_LIMIT_OLD:
            rebate = min(raw_tax, REBATE_CAP_OLD)

    if rebate > 0:
        raw_tax -= rebate
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rebate under Section 87A",
            "amount": str(-rebate),
            "clause": "Sec 87A"
        })

    # Marginal relief for Rebate 87A (New regime only)
    if is_new and taxable_income > REBATE_LIMIT_NEW:
        excess_income = taxable_income - REBATE_LIMIT_NEW
        if raw_tax > excess_income:
            rebate_mr = raw_tax - excess_income
            raw_tax -= rebate_mr
            trace.append({
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": "Marginal relief on Rebate under Section 87A",
                "amount": str(-rebate_mr),
                "clause": "Sec 87A"
            })

    # Surcharge
    surcharge = Decimal("0")
    applicable_threshold = None
    applicable_surcharge_rate = Decimal("0")
    
    thresholds = SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS
    rates = SURCHARGE_RATES_NEW if is_new else SURCHARGE_RATES_OLD
    if is_new:
        thresholds = thresholds[:3]
        rates = rates[:3]

    for t, r in zip(thresholds, rates):
        if taxable_income > t:
            applicable_threshold = t
            applicable_surcharge_rate = r

    if applicable_threshold is not None:
        surcharge = raw_tax * applicable_surcharge_rate
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": f"Surcharge at {applicable_surcharge_rate*100}%",
            "amount": str(surcharge),
            "clause": "First Schedule"
        })

        # Surcharge Marginal Relief
        # Tax + Surcharge at exact threshold
        # Find rate at threshold
        lower_rate_idx = thresholds.index(applicable_threshold) - 1
        lower_rate = rates[lower_rate_idx] if lower_rate_idx >= 0 else Decimal("0")
        
        # Calculate tax on threshold income
        thresh_income = applicable_threshold
        thresh_tax = Decimal("0")
        for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
            if thresh_income <= lower:
                break
            upper_bound = upper if upper is not None else thresh_income
            taxable_in_slab = min(thresh_income, upper_bound) - lower
            if taxable_in_slab > 0:
                thresh_tax += taxable_in_slab * rate
        
        thresh_surcharge = thresh_tax * lower_rate
        max_allowed_total = (thresh_tax + thresh_surcharge) + (taxable_income - applicable_threshold)
        actual_total = raw_tax + surcharge

        if actual_total > max_allowed_total:
            surcharge_mr = actual_total - max_allowed_total
            surcharge -= surcharge_mr
            trace.append({
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": "Marginal relief on Surcharge",
                "amount": str(-surcharge_mr),
                "clause": "First Schedule"
            })

    tax_after_surcharge = raw_tax + surcharge

    # Health and Education Cess
    cess = tax_after_surcharge * CESS_RATE
    if cess > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Health and Education Cess at 4%",
            "amount": str(cess),
            "clause": "Finance Act"
        })

    total_tax_unrounded = tax_after_surcharge + cess
    final_tax_payable = round_nearest_ten(total_tax_unrounded)

    tax_rounding_diff = final_tax_payable - total_tax_unrounded
    if tax_rounding_diff != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rounding adjustment to tax payable",
            "amount": str(tax_rounding_diff),
            "clause": "Sec 288B"
        })

    return {
        "total_income": int(total_income),
        "tax_payable": int(final_tax_payable),
        "trace": trace
    }


def compute(inp: dict) -> dict:
    old_res = compute_regime(inp, is_new=False)
    new_res = compute_regime(inp, is_new=True)
    return {
        "old": old_res,
        "new": new_res
    }
